svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 02 · Berkeley · 02/12 Sather Gate (Rare)
svg.desc: The bronze gate on the old south edge of campus. Everyone walks through it eventually. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
